maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from golf course play, Drive Shack and Puttery venues, food and beverage, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumers, corporate event clients and club members; some municipal courses are managed, but players pay.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its Drive Shack and Puttery venues and course management, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other golf courses, entertainment venues or restaurants; discretionary leisure.
